sender_description: Wholesale manager at Sree Plywood Distributors Pvt Ltd, connecting Indian buyers with reliable plywood suppliers in Vietnam.
qualifier_context: We're Rahal from Sree Plywood Distributors Pvt Ltd. We help Indian buyers source high-quality plywood and wood products from reliable Vietnamese manufacturers. Our focus is on long-term partnerships, scalable sourcing, and predictable volume. We actively filter out opportunistic or price-only sellers, inconsistent producers, and those with poor communication. Our goal is to provide a consistent supply of commercial-grade plywood, film-faced plywood, and furniture-grade plywood to Indian buyers.
ideal_customer_profile: Vietnam-based plywood manufacturers and export-focused trading companies with experience supplying international markets, especially India, the Middle East, or Southeast Asia.
what_we_offer: We offer a stable, long-term procurement model for high-quality plywood and wood products. Our focus is on volume-driven sourcing, predictable volume, and consistent quality. We help Vietnamese manufacturers expand their exports to Indian buyers and establish a strong presence in the Indian market.
weak_signals: Pure trading companies with no control over production
